# hydrofabric

`hydrofabric` builds hydrologic modeling fabrics from a reference
hydrographic network. It produced the NOAA Office of Water Prediction’s
National Water Model v4 hydrofabric for the [NextGen
framework](https://github.com/NOAA-OWP/ngen), covering SuperCONUS,
Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico / Virgin Islands.

![An example NextGen hydrofabric: reconciled flowlines (light blue),
flowpaths (dark blue, weighted by drainage area), divides (grey) and
nexuses (orange).](reference/figures/example_hydrofabric.png)

An example NextGen hydrofabric: reconciled flowlines (light blue),
flowpaths (dark blue, weighted by drainage area), divides (grey) and
nexuses (orange).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("NOAA-OWP/hydrofabric")
```

Requires GDAL \>= 3.5, GEOS \>= 3.11, PROJ \>= 9, the `arrow` package
for the parquet inputs, and the
[mapshaper](https://github.com/mbloch/mapshaper) command-line tool
(`npm install -g mapshaper`). The
[`hfutils`](https://github.com/NOAA-OWP/hfutils) dependency installs
automatically.

## Pipeline

A build runs in four phases: **refactor** the reference network against
flow direction and accumulation grids, **aggregate** it to distribution
scale, package it as a **NextGen** fabric, and **merge** the per-VPU
products into domains with globally unique identifiers. Every VPU must
pass its invariant checks before it is merged.

![The pipeline, from reference fabric and grids to merged domain
products.](reference/figures/pipeline.svg)

The pipeline, from reference fabric and grids to merged domain products.

![Refactor: reference reaches are split and collapsed into reconciled
reaches, each with its own
divide.](reference/figures/stage_refactor.png)

Refactor: reference reaches are split and collapsed into reconciled
reaches, each with its own divide.

![Aggregate: reconciled reaches are combined into distribution-scale
flowpaths and divides.](reference/figures/stage_aggregate.png)

Aggregate: reconciled reaches are combined into distribution-scale
flowpaths and divides.

![NextGen: flowpaths and divides, with the nexuses that make the network
routable.](reference/figures/stage_nextgen.png)

NextGen: flowpaths and divides, with the nexuses that make the network
routable.

The terms used here (flowpath, divide, flowline, nexus, hydrolocation,
VPU) are those of the [hydrofabric data
model](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hfdatamodel/).

## Usage

One VPU:

``` r

library(hydrofabric)

run_pipeline(
  vpuid               = "01",
  reference_gpkg      = "reference.gpkg",
  hydrolocations_gpkg = "hydrolocations.gpkg",
  fdr_path            = "fdr.vrt",
  fac_path            = "fac.vrt",
  out_dir             = "out"
)
```

The product is `out/vpu_01/ngen_vpu01.gpkg`; intermediates and the
invariant record are in `out/vpu_01/work/`. Each phase is also its own
function:
[`refactor_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/refactor_fabric.md),
[`aggregate_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/aggregate_fabric.md),
[`nextgen_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/nextgen_fabric.md)
and
[`merge_vpus()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/merge_vpus.md).
[`vignette("hydrofabric")`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/articles/hydrofabric.md)
covers national builds and parameters.

## Reproducing the NWM v4 delivery

The staged inputs come with `input_manifest.json`, which records every
file’s checksum. `scripts/run_vpu.R` verifies a local copy against it,
then builds and merges every VPU:

``` sh
cd <inputs>
Rscript run_vpu.R 21     # one VPU
Rscript run_vpu.R all    # every VPU, then the merge
```

## Output

Each product is a GeoPackage with `flowpaths`, `divides`, `flowlines`,
`nexus`, `network`, `hydrolocations`, `pois`, `lakes`, and the
`flowpath-attributes` and `flowline-attributes` routing tables. See
[`vignette("nextgen")`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/articles/nextgen.md)
for the schema and
[`vignette("invariants")`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/articles/invariants.md)
for the checks every product passes.

## Tests

The unit and functional tests, including the acyclic and non-dendritic
network checks, run with `testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat")`.
[`vignette("tests")`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/articles/tests.md)
describes what they cover.

# Package index

## Pipeline

End-to-end pipeline entry points.

- [`run_pipeline()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/run_pipeline.md)
  : Run the end-to-end hydrofabric pipeline for a single VPU
- [`run_vpus()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/run_vpus.md)
  : Build a set of VPUs, then merge them
- [`presplit_reference()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/presplit_reference.md)
  : Pre-split a multi-VPU reference fabric into per-VPU slices
- [`prepare_hydrolocations()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/prepare_hydrolocations.md)
  : Prepare an externally-supplied hydrolocation set for embedding
- [`check_reference_input()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_reference_input.md)
  : Validate a reference fabric before building from it
- [`check_grid_coverage()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_grid_coverage.md)
  : Check that the supplied grids cover the domain
- [`check_hydrolocation_input()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_hydrolocation_input.md)
  : Validate a hydrolocation set before building from it
- [`check_reference_coincident_geometry()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_reference_coincident_geometry.md)
  : Find reference reaches drawn on top of one another
- [`check_reference_divide_pairing()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_reference_divide_pairing.md)
  : Find reference reaches that end outside their own divide
- [`check_reference_downstream_resolves()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_reference_downstream_resolves.md)
  : Find reference reaches whose downstream neighbour is missing
- [`check_reference_severed_terminals()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_reference_severed_terminals.md)
  : Find reference reaches that terminate on a channel that carries on
- [`hf_compare_products()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hf_compare_products.md)
  : Compare a rebuilt product against the one it replaces
- [`hl_reference_index()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hl_reference_index.md)
  : Index a reference for hydrolocation checking
- [`hf_input_manifest()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hf_input_manifest.md)
  : Record the inputs a build read
- [`hf_verify_manifest()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hf_verify_manifest.md)
  : Verify inputs against a recorded manifest
- [`hf_output_manifest()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hf_output_manifest.md)
  : Record what a build produced
- [`hf_verify_output_manifest()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/hf_verify_output_manifest.md)
  : Verify products against an output manifest

## Refactor

Split/collapse flowlines and raster-partition divides.

- [`refactor_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/refactor_fabric.md)
  : Refactor a reference hydrofabric (split, collapse, reconcile;
  refactor phase)
- [`refactor_flowlines()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/refactor_flowlines.md)
  : Refactor reference flowlines into reconciled reaches
- [`reconcile_collapsed_flowlines()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/reconcile_collapsed_flowlines.md)
  : Reconcile collapsed flowlines
- [`split_flowlines()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/split_flowlines.md)
  : Split flowlines (sequential, flowpath_id-based)
- [`events_to_exclude_cats()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/events_to_exclude_cats.md)
  : Build exclude_cats from event/split_event data
- [`reconcile_divides()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/reconcile_divides.md)
  : Reconcile divides to refactored flowlines (CRS-aware, lr-capable)
- [`partition_reconcile_divides()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/partition_reconcile_divides.md)
  : Partition and Reconcile Divides with Raster-Based Splitting
- [`partition_reconcile_divides_from_objects()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/partition_reconcile_divides_from_objects.md)
  : Partition and Reconcile Divides from In-Memory Objects

## Aggregate

Aggregate the network and divides to distribution scale.

- [`aggregate_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/aggregate_fabric.md)
  : Aggregate a refactored fabric to the distribution network (aggregate
  phase)
- [`aggregate_network()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/aggregate_network.md)
  : Aggregate flowpath network topology without divide geometry
- [`construct_agg_divides()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/construct_agg_divides.md)
  : Construct aggregated divides from Stage-1 rec_div via rec_id_list
- [`prepare_network()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/prepare_network.md)
  : Prepare Hydrologic Network
- [`add_network_type()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/add_network_type.md)
  : Annotate Flowpaths and Divides with Type Info
- [`extend_flowpaths_to_mainstem()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/extend_flowpaths_to_mainstem.md)
  : Extend aggregated flowpath geometry along its main-stem
  sub-flowlines

## NextGen

Build the NextGen product and finalize the data model.

- [`nextgen_fabric()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/nextgen_fabric.md)
  : Build the NextGen data model from refactored + aggregated layers
  (nextgen phase)
- [`nextgen_from_gpkg()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/nextgen_from_gpkg.md)
  : Build a NextGen hydrofabric from a single GeoPackage
- [`add_flowlines()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/add_flowlines.md)
  : Add Sub-Flowline Segments to Aggregated Hydrofabric
- [`build_aspatial_network()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/build_aspatial_network.md)
  : Build an aspatial long-form network crosswalk
- [`enforce_flowpath_flowdir()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/enforce_flowpath_flowdir.md)
  : Enforce upstream-\>downstream orientation on aggregated flowpath
  geometry
- [`flag_flowpath_constituents()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/flag_flowpath_constituents.md)
  : Flag whether each flowline is a direct constituent of its flowpath's
  line
- [`flag_routeable_flowlines()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/flag_routeable_flowlines.md)
  : Flag the routeable flowlines (the routing network)
- [`add_upstream_index()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/add_upstream_index.md)
  : Add a nested-set upstream index to a hydrofabric GeoPackage
- [`finalize_data_model()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/finalize_data_model.md)
  : Finalize NextGen output to the Lynker hydrofabric data model spec

## Global merge

Merge per-VPU outputs into domain products with global ids.

- [`merge_vpus()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/merge_vpus.md)
  : Merge per-VPU fabrics into domain products with globally unique IDs

## QA, lineage & invariants

The correctness contract and reference-id traceability.

- [`check_invariants()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/check_invariants.md)
  : Pipeline invariant checks

- [`enforce_integer_ids()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/enforce_integer_ids.md)
  : Enforce integer typing and indexes on hydrofabric id columns

- [`lineage_build()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/lineage_build.md)
  : Build the initial lineage table from refactor_flowlines output

- [`lineage_attach_aggregated()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/lineage_attach_aggregated.md)
  : Attach aggregated flowpath IDs to a lineage table

- [`lineage_attach_ngen()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/lineage_attach_ngen.md)
  :

  Attach NextGen IDs (`fp-N`, `cat-N`) to a lineage table

- [`lineage_member_csv()`](https://lynker-spatial.github.io/hydrofabric/reference/lineage_member_csv.md)
  :

  Recompute `member_comid` CSV strings from a lineage table
